description: The arp_multi_ip traffic from a proxy-ARP router: the gateway's MAC answers for 20 addresses of the remote subnet 10.20.0.0/24. A pass rule for replies from that subnet (the fix suggested in rules.conf) suppresses multi_ip; without it the same traffic fires 1000805 as in arp_multi_ip.
extra_rules: pass arp 10.20.0.0/24 any -> any any (msg:"proxy ARP router"; arp_op:reply; sid:1900001;)
